name: Discord Wastes
summary: A shattered expanse of Kuua where Discord energy tears the land apart.
description: The Discord Wastes are a chaotic, unstable region where raw Discord energy ruptures the terrain. Jagged fissures, warped gravity, arcane storms, and violent manifestations dominate the landscape. Muramite forces avoid deep penetration into the Wastes, using only fortified outposts to monitor activity. Resistance agents rarely enter, and those who do seldom return. The Wastes represent the purest, most dangerous expression of Discord’s corruption in Kuua.
